client: installed Pi McpServerConnection + createMcpToolDefinition + stdio vsrMcpProxy
exposedDescription: Minimal examples (IDs illustrative; use a discovered scene_id and fresh request_id per operation): {"request_id":1,"scene_id":0,"kind":"objects"}; {"request_id":2,"scene_id":0,"kind":"layers"}; {"request_id":3,"scene_id":0,"kind":"nodes","name":"RootDelta"}. Omit unused filters; name="" means the exact empty stored name, not no filter. Empty name_contains matches all names; omitted/empty cursor starts the first page. Filters intersect: handle plus name selects that same node only, not its children; parent_handle selects direct children. Use handles and node_edit_version/structural_version/ancestry_version from fresh inspection, never zero/invented placeholders. Copy node edit versions verbatim into version; world edits also require ancestry_version. World position is the node origin (local [0,0,0] transformed by its world matrix), not geometry centre or bounds centre. Transform inheritance example, identity linear transforms: RootDelta local x=0 has child BodyTop local x=1, so origins are 0 and 1. Moving only RootDelta by +2 in local x moves both origins once to 2 and 3; BodyTop local x stays 1. Applying +2 separately to both local positions puts BodyTop at world x=5 (double movement). For two selected sibling roots, move those roots independently; do not choose their unselected common parent or move unselected siblings. These names are illustrative, not inferred assemblies. Page through scene objects/parameters (default) or layers with live root handles. Layer filters: exact stored name, exact layer handle, and literal case-sensitive name_contains intersect. Object/node-only filters reject for layers. Nodes expose full row-major local/world matrices with column-vector mathematics, local position, and faithful degree-based azimuth(Y), elevation(X), roll(Z), composed Y then X then Z, and scale. Unavailable world/SRT observations carry explicit reasons; edit affordances describe representability, not write permission. Node filters: name, name_contains, handle, node_kind, layer_handle and parent_handle intersect. Object filters: optional exact name, handle, ANARI object_type and object_subtype filters intersect with literal, case-sensitive name_contains (not regex/glob). Filter strings are limited to 4096 UTF-8 bytes. Stored names are matched resumably, not against previews; name_work counts byte comparisons (including substring fallback), with 65536 per operation and 4096 per safe-point slice. Work exhaustion returns a continuation. Default page size 64, maximum 256; supported inspection kinds: objects, layers, nodes.
limitations: Tests the real installed Pi tool-definition/client/stdio/native path, not an upstream gateway/model-generated payload or viewport image parity.
